eternal anima limited edition - nintendo.name: Eternal Anima Limited Edition - Nintendo Switch 2
eternal anima limited edition - nintendo.description: In a world without land, consumed by an endless sea, the floating kingdom of Urvis Ael stands as the last bastion of civilization. Its people enjoy peaceful lives under the rule of their omnipotent leader, the Almighty, bound by one unbreakable law: no progress whatsoever. After challenging this ideal, Wade is pursued as a heretic, escapes to the Forbidden Seas, and searches for a new world. As he journeys through the past and present of four lost continents, he and his companions discover what it means to inherit wisdom passed down through the ages. With Wade's powers of Psychometry, he can decipher past memories that dwell within objects, allowing him to inherit Abilities and Classes in combat. Wade also uses Future Sight in battle to predict when enemies will act and what the outcome will be each turn. Choose your commands strategically, and you can alter Wade’s predictions — Prepare for incoming attacks or act first to prevent enemy actions entirely. Crafted by a team of acclaimed RPG veterans, featuring gorgeous visuals inspired by the golden age of RPGs, and designed with modern sensibilities, Eternal Anima is an epic where you must save the past to free the present.
